species.range: Worldwide. The displayed anatomy is an adult male reference atlas, with a separately sourced cortical neuron. It does not represent population variation.
species.summary: Explore the inside of a human using selectable anatomy from Z-Anatomy and BodyParts3D. Reveal bones, muscles, organs, connective tissues, nervous, cardiovascular and lymphatic structures. A separate Allen Institute neuron can be inspected at microscopic scale. Shared joint demonstrations explain spatial relationships; tissue mechanics and physiological activity are not simulated.

visual.description: Registered source anatomy with 3,875 named atlas components, reduced for display. Layer colors are instructional. All body layers share one authored rig. A separate measured cortical neuron retains micrometre dimensions; its whole-body anchor is illustrative.

viewerRig.description: Source joint pivots and shared skin weights; finite authored movements without measured tissue mechanics.

anatomy.name: Brain and spinal cord
anatomy.description: Select source brain regions and the spinal cord in the internal anatomy panel. The cell microscopy view is a separate measured specimen, not an atlas-registered connectome.

anatomy.name: Thoracic organs
anatomy.description: Reveal source heart, lungs, vessels and regional structures. Colors distinguish systems; the study does not calculate breathing, pumping or blood flow.

anatomy.name: Pelvic anatomy
anatomy.description: Explore the adult male atlas and associated organ, musculoskeletal and neurovascular components. Individual and sex-related anatomical variation is outside this reference.

behaviors.label: Anatomical position
behaviors.description: Source adult reference pose with palms directed forwards. The reference is held without a balance or muscle-force simulation.

behaviors.label: Elbow flexion
behaviors.description: Right elbow flexion through an authored 110-degree joint demonstration and return. Source bones remain rigid; muscles, nerves and vessels follow shared authored weights. Tissue strains, muscle shortening and movement timing are uncalibrated.

behaviors.label: Shoulder abduction
behaviors.description: Raise and return the right arm. The authored demonstration combines small clavicular and scapular rotations with glenohumeral abduction. The timeline and soft-tissue deformation are illustrative.

behaviors.label: Knee flexion
behaviors.description: An authored 60-degree right knee flexion demonstration and return, with a fixed femur. Joint translation, patellar tracking, balance and tissue contact are not calculated.
